# Material 3 colour scheme from one seed colour

Research for #128 (part of #125). Question: how to derive a Material 3 light + dark scheme, as CSS
custom properties, from one seed colour in a zero-runtime-dependency Preact app; build-time vs
runtime vs a precomputed CSS file, given the seed changes once (when the app icon is picked).

## Recommendation

**Precomputed CSS file, generated by a checked-in script** — not by hand from Theme Builder, and
not on every build or at runtime.

- `@material/material-color-utilities` as a **devDependency**, pinned to `0.3.0` (see
  [0.4.0 ESM bug](#040-is-broken-under-plain-node-esm)).
- A small script (e.g. `npm run theme -- '#rrggbb'`) builds `SchemeTonalSpot(seed, isDark, 0)`
  for light and dark and writes `src/theme.css`: `:root { ... }` for light plus
  `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { :root { ... } }`, one `--md-sys-color-<role>` per role in
  [the role list](#colour-roles-to-emit).
- Commit the generated CSS. Rerun the script when the seed changes; the diff shows every role
  that moved.

Why:

- Seed changes once. Runtime generation pays ~20 KB gzip and a flash of unthemed content on every
  load to recompute a constant ([measured](#runtime-cost)).
- A Vite plugin regenerates the same constant on every build and adds a plugin to keep working
  across Vite majors, for no benefit over a committed file.
- The Theme Builder route yields the same kind of file but through a manual GUI step: not
  reproducible from the repo, and the library version and scheme settings behind it are not
  recorded ([Theme Builder](#material-theme-builder)).
- The script keeps the seed in code next to `src/theme.ts` (`themeColor`, which feeds the PWA
  manifest `theme_color`), so both change in one commit.

## Options compared

| | Build-time (Vite plugin / script each build) | Runtime (in the app bundle) | Precomputed CSS file (committed) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ships to the browser | CSS only | ~89 KB min / ~20 KB gzip of JS plus CSS vars set by JS | CSS only |
| Runtime dependency | None | `@material/material-color-utilities` | None |
| First paint | Themed | Unthemed until JS runs (unless a fallback CSS is also shipped) | Themed |
| Reproducible from repo | Yes | Yes | Yes if generated by a checked-in script; no if exported from Theme Builder by hand |
| Cost when seed never changes | Recomputes every build | Recomputes every page load | None |
| Needed only if | Seed comes from build input (env, per-deploy branding) | Seed chosen by the user / at runtime (e.g. wallpaper, user picker) | Seed is a fixed constant |

Runtime is the only option that supports a user-picked colour; nothing in #125 asks for that, and
the zero-UI-deps constraint rules it out anyway. Build-time and precomputed produce the same output;
precomputed just runs the generator when the input changes instead of on every build.

## How generation works (primary source: material-color-utilities)

- The library's current API is `DynamicScheme` and its variant subclasses. The dev guide:
  "The recommended way to generate a scheme from a source color is to use a scheme variant
  constructor, such as `SchemeTonalSpot`", TypeScript form `new SchemeTonalSpot(hct, false, 0.0)`;
  "source color (formerly called seed color)"; contrast `0.0` is default, `0.5`/`1.0` higher,
  `-1.0` reduced.
  ([dev_guide/creating_color_scheme.md](https://github.com/material-foundation/material-color-utilities/blob/main/dev_guide/creating_color_scheme.md))
- Variants: Content, Expressive, Fidelity, Fruit salad, Monochrome, Neutral, Rainbow, Tonal spot,
  Vibrant (same doc). `SchemeTonalSpot` is documented in source as "The default Material You theme
  on Android 12 and 13" (`scheme/scheme_tonal_spot.d.ts`, npm 0.4.0).
- The README's `themeFromSourceColor` + `applyTheme` example is the **old** path: it builds the
  `Scheme` class, whose source comment reads "DEPRECATED. The `Scheme` class is deprecated in favor
  of `DynamicScheme`" (`scheme/scheme.d.ts`; `utils/theme_utils.js` calls `Scheme.light/dark`).
  `Scheme` lacks the surface-container and fixed roles. Do not use it.
  ([typescript/README.md](https://github.com/material-foundation/material-color-utilities/tree/main/typescript))
- Role values are read as getters on the scheme (`scheme.primary`, ARGB int) or via
  `MaterialDynamicColors.primary.getArgb(scheme)`; `hexFromArgb` converts to `#rrggbb` (same dev
  guide).
- `applyTheme` names tokens `--md-sys-color-<kebab-role>` (`utils/theme_utils.js`,
  `setSchemeProperties`), matching Material Web's convention: "Tokens follow the naming convention
  `--md-sys-color-<token>`"
  ([material-web docs/theming/color.md](https://github.com/material-components/material-web/blob/main/docs/theming/color.md)).
- Tonal spot does not keep the seed's exact hue/chroma: seed `#2563eb` (current `themeColor`) gives
  light `primary` `#4b5c92`. If the icon colour must appear verbatim, use `SchemeFidelity` or
  `SchemeContent` ("a fidelity scheme: the tones of color roles may depend on the tone of the
  seed color", dev guide) — a choice to make when the icon is picked.
- `DynamicScheme` takes a `specVersion` of `'2021' | '2025'`, default `'2021'`
  (`dynamiccolor/color_spec.d.ts`, `dynamic_scheme.d.ts` in 0.4.0). Keep the default; the 2025
  spec changes tones (e.g. dark `surface-container-lowest` goes to `#000000`) and adds `*-dim`
  roles that Material Web does not define.

### 0.4.0 is broken under plain Node ESM

npm `0.4.0` (2026-01-21, latest) ships extensionless relative imports, e.g.
`scheme/scheme_tonal_spot.js`: `import { DynamicScheme } from '../dynamiccolor/dynamic_scheme';`.
Importing the package from Node fails with `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` — reproduced locally, and open
upstream as
[material-color-utilities#195](https://github.com/material-foundation/material-color-utilities/issues/195)
("Fails in 0.4.0, works in 0.3.0"). Bundlers resolve it, so it only bites a Node script or a Vite
plugin (Vite loads config-file dependencies through Node).

`0.3.0` (2024-06-24) runs under plain Node and produced **byte-identical CSS** to 0.4.0 (bundled)
for seed `#2563eb`, light and dark, all 49 roles. Pin `0.3.0`; revisit when #195 is fixed.

### Runtime cost

Bundling `SchemeTonalSpot` + `hexFromArgb` + a loop setting properties (esbuild, minified, ESM):
88,728 B minified, 20,317 B gzip -9. That code computes a constant.

## Material Theme Builder

- Google's web tool and Figma plugin; the library README recommends them "into the design
  workflow"
  ([material-color-utilities README](https://github.com/material-foundation/material-color-utilities#readme)).
- It "generat[es] accessible light and dark color schemes" and has "built-in code export"; its
  **Color Match** option "will use the color inputs in place of _Container_ roles to provide color
  fidelity"
  ([material-theme-builder README](https://github.com/material-foundation/material-theme-builder)).
  Export includes a "Material Theme (JSON)" file with `schemes` and `palettes`
  ([material-theme-builder#308](https://github.com/material-foundation/material-theme-builder/issues/308),
  reporting palettes in that export disagreeing with the schemes); Material Web's docs also point
  to it as a generator
  ([color.md](https://github.com/material-components/material-web/blob/main/docs/theming/color.md)).
- Its source is not published (the repo holds the README and issues) and the export records no
  library version or variant, so a later regeneration cannot be shown to match. Useful to preview
  a candidate seed visually before running the script, not as the source of the committed file.

## Colour roles to emit

49 roles — exactly Material Web's `--md-sys-color-*` set
([tokens/_md-sys-color.scss](https://github.com/material-components/material-web/blob/main/tokens/_md-sys-color.scss));
every one is a getter on `DynamicScheme` in material-color-utilities. Emit each as
`--md-sys-color-<role>` in both light and dark blocks.

- Primary: `primary`, `on-primary`, `primary-container`, `on-primary-container`, `inverse-primary`
- Secondary: `secondary`, `on-secondary`, `secondary-container`, `on-secondary-container`
- Tertiary: `tertiary`, `on-tertiary`, `tertiary-container`, `on-tertiary-container`
- Error: `error`, `on-error`, `error-container`, `on-error-container`
- Fixed (same in light and dark): `primary-fixed`, `primary-fixed-dim`, `on-primary-fixed`,
  `on-primary-fixed-variant`, `secondary-fixed`, `secondary-fixed-dim`, `on-secondary-fixed`,
  `on-secondary-fixed-variant`, `tertiary-fixed`, `tertiary-fixed-dim`, `on-tertiary-fixed`,
  `on-tertiary-fixed-variant`
- Surface: `surface`, `on-surface`, `surface-variant`, `on-surface-variant`, `surface-dim`,
  `surface-bright`, `surface-container-lowest`, `surface-container-low`, `surface-container`,
  `surface-container-high`, `surface-container-highest`, `inverse-surface`, `inverse-on-surface`,
  `surface-tint`
- Legacy neutral (kept for compatibility; same value as `surface`/`on-surface` in the 2021 spec):
  `background`, `on-background`
- Outline and effects: `outline`, `outline-variant`, `shadow`, `scrim`

Material Web: "All tokens have a corresponding `--md-sys-color-on-<token>` for content color with
accessible contrast", and all surface tokens use `on-surface` or `on-surface-variant` for their
content ([color.md](https://github.com/material-components/material-web/blob/main/docs/theming/color.md)).

Not emitted: `primary-dim`, `secondary-dim`, `tertiary-dim`, `error-dim` (2025 spec only; in
`MaterialDynamicColors.allColors` of 0.4.0 but not in Material Web), palette key colours, and
`--md-ref-palette-*` tones (only needed if the CSS picks raw tones, which role-based styling
avoids).

## Sketch of the generator

Verified against 0.3.0 under plain Node (output for `#2563eb` begins
`--md-sys-color-primary: #4b5c92;`):

```js
import { Hct, SchemeTonalSpot, argbFromHex, hexFromArgb } from '@material/material-color-utilities'

const ROLES = [/* the 49 kebab-case names above */]
const camel = (r) => r.replace(/-([a-z])/g, (_, c) => c.toUpperCase())
const block = (seedHex, isDark) => {
  const s = new SchemeTonalSpot(Hct.fromInt(argbFromHex(seedHex)), isDark, 0)
  return ROLES.map((r) => `  --md-sys-color-${r}: ${hexFromArgb(s[camel(r)])};`).join('\n')
}
// write `:root { color-scheme: light dark; ${block(seed, false)} }`
// and `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { :root { ${block(seed, true)} } }`
```

Open for the implementing ticket: variant (tonal spot vs fidelity) once the icon exists; whether the
seed constant lives in `src/theme.ts` (read by the script) or the script's argument; whether a test
asserts the committed CSS matches the script's output for the current seed.
